text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, looks so delicious~~♡ And it's 
packed with all my favorites☆

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I asked the chef to make something 
special! Every single ingredient was 
carefully handpicked just for you, 
Pan-chan~♪

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text:
After dinner, I've booked a helicopter 
cruise! You've always loved sky tours, 
haven't you? After that, let's go shopping 
at our usual jewelry shop!

Thanks to her family, Fusaichi Pandora 
spent a fulfilling day off.
